Frequency Once per ten minutes

Through elaborate magical mirrors, clouding vapors, addling fumes or well positioned tricks of light and sound, you quickly create an inscrutable box for a foe, regardless of how they might perceive the world. Target a creature within 60 feet of you, and attempt a @Check[visionary-skill|against:will] check against their Will DC.

On a success, a creature becomes incapable of using any of their senses for 1 round, and is considered @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}. During their turn, they can take an action to attempt a Will saving throw or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} check on their turn against your Deception DC, ending the effect on a success. If you critically succeeded, the creature cannot attempt this check. If you failed the check, the creature still remains off-guard for the round, though they are still able to see through your tricks. They can attempt the saving throw or Seek check to end the effect early.
